Entry.Notes: Info on how to unlock each title for https://aselia.fandom.com/wiki/ToP:NDX_-_Chester_Burklight:_Titles

Entry.JapaneseText: 妹想いの優しい兄貴。今は亡きその面影をそっと 心の鏡に映す。その優しさは子どもたちに向けられる
Entry.EnglishText: A kind brother who was thoughtful about his younger sister. Now that she's no longer alive, her memory is gently reflected in the mirror inside his heart. That kindness is now directed towards children.
Entry.Notes: Julito: Too much of a literal translation that maybe could be less literal.

Entry.JapaneseText: 修行中の弓使い。引いた弦を離し、矢が飛んだ後も 集中した心はそこに。弓矢の基本は忘れぬように
Entry.EnglishText: An archer in training. Remain focused even after releasing the string as the arrow flies. Remember the basics of archery.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル５、弓の構えが堂に入る。当たらなければ、 何度だって弓を引く。地獄の果てまで追いかける
Entry.EnglishText: Level 5, having mastered his bow stance, if he misses, he'll draw his bow again and again. He'll chase his mark to the ends of Hell.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル１０、矢の尖端で宙空を切り拓く弓使い。 鋭い閃光の軌跡は、まるで天を廻る彗星のごとし
Entry.EnglishText: Level 10, an archer who splits the very air with the tips of his arrows. The sharp glint of light trails like comets in the sky.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル３０、百発必中、狙った的ははずさない。 オレの視界に入った時、おまえはすでに消えている
Entry.EnglishText: Level 30, 100% accuracy, never miss a target. When you enter my field of vision, you're already gone.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル５０、早さ、破壊力、命中力すべてにおいて 磨き抜かれた弓使い。鋼の切っ先は悪を粉々に砕く
Entry.EnglishText: Level 50, an archer with honed expertise on speed, destructive power and accuracy. The point of steel of his arrows shatter evil to pieces.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル８０、目をつむっていても、矢が当たる。 心は明鏡止水、無の極致にある最高の腕前
Entry.EnglishText: Level 80, even with closed eyes, the arrows won't miss. A clear and serene mind, the supreme ability with the culmination of nothingness.
Entry.Notes: Julito: にある is making me doubt here Pegi: all good here

Entry.JapaneseText: 見えない努力が開花する。天才も秀才も関係ない。 継続は力、七転び八起き。努力は何よりも尊い
Entry.EnglishText: One's hidden efforts will pay off, no matter if you're a genius or prodigy. Perseverance is power - fall down 7 times, get back up 8. Effort is more valuable than anything else.

Entry.JapaneseText: 体中が筋肉のかたまり。子どもなら１０人だって、 吊り下げられるその二の腕。筋肉バカとか言うな！
Entry.EnglishText: His whole body's one lump of muscle. Those biceps can hold 10 kids off those guns. But you better not call him a musclehead!

Entry.JapaneseText: その昔、マッハ少年に勝った証。「激」だけに その早さは想像以上。音よりも光よりも、早く！
Entry.EnglishText: Proof that he defeated the Mach Boy. "Super" doesn't do justice to his speed. He's faster than sound, faster than light!

Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 59 I don't think the title is translated correctly - it seems to be alluding more to him being an older brother figure.

Entry.JapaneseText: 誰もが頼れるたくましさ。みんな憧れる快活さ。 面倒見のいいみんなの兄貴。あんた……立派だよ……
Entry.EnglishText: He's got a dependable strength and a cheerfulness all admire. This big bro looks out for all. He's... He's truly remarkable...
